name: 44053 · Lorain, OH
findings: ZIP 44053 (Lorain) has 90 nonprofit organizations. 42 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44053 (Lorain) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 44053 (Lorain) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 31 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.
